about_the_game:
GO WILD WITH YOUR INK!


Unleash your inner beast and give your studio a primal makeover with the Animal Ink Society Style Pack! Tattuga Bay's customers are looking for fiercely unique body art, and this pack delivers a menagerie of animal-inspired designs, furniture, and fashion.

From the deepest jungle to the colorful reef, you'll find everything you need to transform your parlor into a den of majestic style. Decorate with a cozy Hippo Couch, illuminate your workspace with the brilliant glow of a Peacock Lamp, and make your mark with exclusive new stencils, including one Rare and one Legendary design.

Your shop is your habitat—time to make it an apex predator in the tattoo world!

New Content Include:
  • Fierce Tattoos: 4 new tattoo stencils, featuring one Rare and one Legendary design.
  • Wild Wardrobe: New outfits for each body type, 4 new hairstyles, new glasses, necklace, and earrings.
  • The Jungle Look: Decorate with the Trunk-Top Side Table, Shell Seat, Purr-Spective Mirror, Peacock Divider, and the Chill’n’Scratch Post (including a cat!).
  • Patterned Walls & Floors: Adorn your studio with Zebra Wallpaper, Peacock Wood Paneling, and Paw-Tiled Parquet.
  • Outdoor Attractions: Draw in crowds with a Feline Shop Sign and an adorable Dog House (including a dog!).
  • And more! 25 new furniture objects in total: lamps, plants, carpets, shelves, and frames to fully embrace the Animal Ink Society aesthetic.
